mapper.sql: CASE WHEN s.birth_date IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE LEAST(GREATEST((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age((s.applied_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, s.birth_date))::int / 10) * 10, 10), 70)::text END
mapper.select: WITH events AS ( SELECT AS stat_key, d.name, 1 AS issued, 0 AS revoked FROM tb_learning_badges b LEFT JOIN tb_badge_definitions d ON d.id = b.definition_id WHERE b.issued_at >= #{from} AND b.issued_at < #{to} UNION ALL SELECT , d.name, 0, 1 FROM tb_learning_badges b LEFT JOIN tb_badge_definitions d ON d.id = b.definition_id WHERE b.revoked_at >= #{from} AND b.revoked_at < #{to} ) SELECT stat_key, MAX(name) AS label, SUM(issued) AS issued, SUM(revoked) AS revoked FROM events GROUP BY stat_key ORDER BY stat_key
